notes: Routing rules. Engine-object editor (owner direction 2026-10-29, ui_unified_design.rst decision 15). Vitess keeps one global rule set and replaces it whole (ApplyRoutingRules), so the editor reopens with the current rules and alter sends the edited set. One target per rule: ApplyRoutingRules accepts several, but vtgate then refuses to route the table (live, 23.0.3). The provider's JSON 'apply' operation stays for the legacy dialog. Round trip (tools/tests/test_ui_descriptor_roundtrip_vitess.py, live 23.0.3): reopen, add a rule and query through it, reopen and add a second with the first kept, the provider post-state check confirms each, a two-target rule is refused at plan. Keyspace and shard routing rules added 2026-10-30: each rule set the edit sends is replaced whole (ApplyKeyspaceRoutingRules, ApplyShardRoutingRules) and read back; a shard rule must name a shard the target keyspace has (vtctld accepts one it lacks). Mirror rules are shown read only.

fields.label: Routing rules
fields.help: Each row sends queries for a source table to one target table. Removing every row clears the rules.

columns.label: Source
columns.help: keyspace.table, optionally with @replica or @rdonly. An unqualified table applies only to sessions with no keyspace selected.

fields.label: Keyspace routing rules
fields.help: Queries for a source keyspace go to the target keyspace (as after MoveTables).

columns.label: Source keyspace
columns.help: May name a keyspace that does not exist; its queries then go to the target.

fields.label: Shard routing rules
fields.help: Queries for one shard of a source keyspace go to that shard of the target keyspace (partial MoveTables).

columns.label: Shard
columns.help: Key range, e.g. -80; the target keyspace must have this shard.

fields.label: Mirror rules
fields.help: Read only: vtctld has no command to apply mirror rules; MoveTables mirrortraffic sets them. Row fields follow the Vitess MirrorRule message; not yet seen with live data.

fields.label: Rebuild cells
fields.help: Cells whose serving VSchema is rebuilt; empty means all.

fields.label: Skip serving VSchema rebuild
fields.help: vtgate keeps routing by the old rules until the serving VSchema is rebuilt.
